info.title: Mane Man API
info.description: mm-api, served at https://{host}/api/*. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header.

fields.description: invalid_request: the fields that failed validation, never their values; superseded: what changed under the caller.

technician.description: Their first name, and nothing else of theirs

at.description: When ops moved the job to them; null where nothing recorded when

moved.description: superseded, to a technician's phone, for a job given to another technician: whom, and when (docs/open-points.md, item 92).

earliest_at.description: too_early_to_arrive, to a technician's check-in or start: the earliest moment the job takes one.

version_id.description: Cloudflare Worker version ID serving this request.

version_tag.description: Tag given at upload: the git commit SHA in remote environments.

d1.description: ok: reachable and marked as this environment's database. unmarked: no identity row. mismatch: marked as another environment's database.

cron_completed_at.description: When the five-minute cron last finished a run; null before its first, or when the database is not this environment's. Information only: status does not depend on it.

on.description: The day in India these are in force.

tier.description: The tier of the two figures below: each kind's standard.

services.description: Every service offered and priced today, a kind at a time, in the console's order. A first fit's are the hair systems ops offer; none while ops offer none.

amount_ex_gst.description: In paise, before GST: the main figure.

amount.description: In paise, GST included: what the client pays.

NumberCode.description: The code is on its way to the number on WhatsApp.

name.description: The name typed beside the number.

attempts_left.description: 0 means the code is now void.

windows.description: true where booking that window now would be taken; false where it is full.

days.description: The days the form offers: 14, from tomorrow in India.

state.description: A slot is held for a "booked" one; a "requested" one waits for ops, self-serve booking being off.

area.description: The area once ops have named it, its city until then.

credits.description: Whether the invite's service visits apply.

invite.description: valid; expired, when the invite held for them on a waitlist lapsed 12 months after their area launched, so the consultation is still free and the invite's visits do not apply; or unknown: no invite came with it, or a code we do not have.

one_visit.description: true: the consultation and the first fit in one visit were booked, or asked for.

discount_code.description: The code given, as it stands on the booking or on the request ops book from; null when none was given, or another booking took the code's last use a moment before, and the booking stands without it.

code.description: In capitals, as it is kept.

value.description: Per cent for a percentage; paise before GST for an amount.

cap.description: The most a percentage takes off, in paise before GST; null for none.

access_notes.description: For the technician, from the day before the visit: gate code, parking.

area.description: Null until ops have named the area, and for a pincode we do not know.

credits.description: Whether the invite's service visits apply.

invite.description: valid; expired, when the invite held for them on a waitlist lapsed 12 months after their area launched, so the consultation is still free and the invite's visits do not apply; or unknown: no invite came with it, or a code we do not have.

referrer_first_name.description: Only if the referrer agreed to be named, and naming is on (REFERRER_NAME_ON_INVITE).

card.description: Which card the invite shows, and its version for the preview's URL.

area.description: The area's name once ops have named it; null until then, and for a pincode we do not know.

state.description: A slot is held for a "booked" one; a "requested" one waits for ops, self-serve booking being off.

area.description: The area once ops have named it, its city until then.

credits.description: Whether the invite's service visits apply.

invite.description: valid; expired, when the invite held for them on a waitlist lapsed 12 months after their area launched, so the consultation is still free and the invite's visits do not apply; or unknown: no invite came with it, or a code we do not have.

one_visit.description: true: the consultation and the first fit in one visit were booked, or asked for.

area.description: Null until ops have named the area, and for a pincode we do not know.

credits.description: Whether the invite's service visits apply.

invite.description: valid; expired, when the invite held for them on a waitlist lapsed 12 months after their area launched, so the consultation is still free and the invite's visits do not apply; or unknown: no invite came with it, or a code we do not have.

referrer_visits.description: The free service visits the client who sent the invite gets; 0 for none.

friend_visits.description: The free service visits the friend they invited gets; 0 for none.

valid_days.description: How many days the credits last from the grant.

ReferralReward.description: What each side is given when a friend's first fit is done, as it stands now. A grant is given what is in force when the friend is fitted, and keeps it.

upload_url.description: A path on this host. PUT the photo there within five minutes, as image/jpeg or image/png.

photo_consent.description: The photo notice was agreed to.

notice_version.description: The photo notice shown: the current one, the only one recorded.

hair_color.description: From the browser's detector; unknown if it could not tell.

GenerateRequest.description: The look, for the stage the gate's claim gave the try-on.

ClaimResponse.description: Saved: the look goes to this number on WhatsApp once it is made.

number_code_id.description: The code that proved the number (POST /api/number-code/verify). It proves it for 30 minutes after it was entered.

stage.description: The hair-loss stage the visitor picked: the lead's, and the one the look is made for.

notice_version.description: The gate's notice the page showed: the current one, the only one a claim may record, when left out (docs/decisions/0104-the-try-ons-look-on-whatsapp-only.md).

Attribution.description: Where the visitor came from, as the page saw it. All optional.

available.description: False while WhatsApp cannot send a look: the try-on does not run, and the page says so.

Look.description: The look this browser has had: its state alone. The look goes to WhatsApp only.

purpose.description: What is no longer sent. The same answer when it had been stopped already.

503.description: The database is unreachable or belongs to another environment

get.summary: The prices the site publishes, from the price book, in force today. Cacheable for a minute.

503.description: unavailable: the book lacks the standard service visit or replacement, so the site shows its own

post.summary: Send a code on WhatsApp to prove a number typed into the site

202.description: The code is on its way

429.description: rate_limited: too many codes for this number today, or from this address this hour

503.description: busy: today's ceiling on codes is reached; unavailable: Turnstile could not be reached

post.summary: Check a code. The right one proves its number for 30 minutes

200.description: Right; or wrong, with the attempts left

410.description: code_expired: expired, already entered, or void after five wrong codes

get.summary: The days and windows the booking form can book, open or full. Cacheable for a minute.

schema.description: The consultation alone, or the consultation and fit in one visit.

parameters.description: The consultation alone, or the consultation and fit in one visit.
parameters.name: plan

400.description: invalid_request: fields names the pincode or the plan

422.description: not_bookable: the pincode is not served

loss_extent.description: Where the hair loss is, as the form's drawings show it. Left out when the visitor does not say.

invite_code.description: The code of an invite this browser opened in the last 30 days. One sent without invite_told, one we do not have, or one not shaped like a code, is ignored: the booking goes ahead without an invite.

invite_told.description: true: beside the invite, the form said that whoever sent it is told when the friend is fitted, and offered to go on without it. The attribution records it.

one_visit.description: true: the consultation and the first fit in one visit, three hours, in the morning or the afternoon; the client chooses the product with the technician and pays once fitted, so nothing is paid here. Left out or false, the consultation alone.

number_code_id.description: The WhatsApp code that proved the number (POST /api/number-code/verify) in the last 30 minutes. One visit needs it, and is refused number_not_proved without it.

discount_code.description: A discount code for the consultation and fit in one visit, as typed, any case: it comes off the product's price at the payment link (docs/decisions/0108-discount-codes.md). A code that does not apply refuses the booking, code_not_applicable, and so does any code with the consultation alone.

consent.description: "You may contact me on WhatsApp about this consultation."

201.description: Booked, or asked for. A number with a consultation still to happen, or past consultations, gets the answer a new number would, books nothing, and is told why on WhatsApp.

400.description: invalid_request: fields names what was refused, address.pincode for an address in another pincode, window for one visit in the evening

403.description: turnstile_failed; number_not_proved: one visit, without a WhatsApp code that proved the number in the last 30 minutes

409.description: taken: that window has gone; idempotency_in_progress: the first request with this key is still running

422.description: not_bookable: the pincode is not served, or the day is not open; code_not_applicable: the discount code does not apply, fields names discount_code; no_product: one visit, on a day the console offers no hair system; idempotency_key_reused: the key was used with a different body

503.description: unavailable: Turnstile could not be reached

403.description: turnstile_failed; look_limit_reached: this browser already has its look

429.description: rate_limited: too many uploads from this address this hour

503.description: busy: today's upload ceiling is reached; unavailable: Turnstile could not be reached; whatsapp_unavailable: WhatsApp cannot send the look, so the try-on does not run

put.summary: Upload the photo: a JPEG or PNG, at most 5 MB and 200 to 4090 px a side

404.description: not_found: no such job, or the link has expired

422.description: photo_invalid_file: not a JPEG or PNG, over 5 MB, or the wrong size

put.summary: Upload the photo's small copy, which a client keeps as their before photo: a JPEG of at most 250 KB and 200 to 1600 px a side
put.description: With the upload link's token, after the photo itself, and only under a photo notice that says a client's try-on is kept (docs/decisions/0084-a-clients-try-on-is-kept.md). The sweeper deletes it with the photo, or with the look, unless its person books a visit.

404.description: not_found: no such job, or the link has expired

409.description: upload_missing: the photo has not been uploaded, or has been deleted; upload_already_received: the copy was; consent_required: the photo notice agreed to keeps no copy

422.description: photo_invalid_file: not a JPEG, over 250 KB, or the wrong size

post.summary: Render the look for an uploaded photo the gate has claimed: one look per visitor

202.description: Queued, or an identical job already exists. job_id may differ from the one sent.

403.description: look_limit_reached: this photo already has its look

409.description: claim_required: the gate has not been given a number to send the look to; upload_missing: the photo has not been uploaded, or has been deleted

429.description: rate_limited: too many renders from this address this hour

503.description: busy: today's render ceiling is reached; whatsapp_unavailable: WhatsApp cannot send the look, so none is made

post.summary: The gate: where to send the look on WhatsApp, given before the look is made

403.description: look_limit_reached: this number had its look in the last thirty days; number_not_proved: no WhatsApp code proved the number in the last 30 minutes

409.description: job_not_claimable: no photo was uploaded, its render was asked for already, or it is another number's; idempotency_in_progress

429.description: rate_limited: this number has had its claims, or its looks, for today

503.description: whatsapp_unavailable: WhatsApp cannot send the look, so the try-on does not run

Whether this browser has had its look, from its mm_look cookie

204.description: This browser has had no look yet

get.summary: A result image, behind the signed link a WhatsApp message carries, which expires

404.description: not_found: the link is invalid or expired, or the result was deleted

503.description: busy: today's result-read ceiling is reached

post.summary: Stops the messages a reminder's or alert's link names, by withdrawing the consent they were sent under

404.description: not_found: the link is not ours, or has expired

post.summary: Evolution's delivery receipts (messages.update) for the WhatsApp messages we sent, and the messages on our number (messages.upsert), where a STOP reply stops our messages

204.description: Taken, or ignored. Either way Evolution need not send it again

404.description: not_found: receipts are not switched on (no EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_TOKEN)

200.description: Taken, or ignored. Either way Razorpay need not send it again

401.description: unauthorized: the signature does not match

404.description: not_found: the webhook is not switched on (no RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET)

409.description: not_ready: a refund of a payment not yet recorded, whose event does not carry it; Razorpay retries it
